SCANNER.FILTER_TYPE_INFO: Static: evaluated once using fundamental data (float, market cap, etc.) to narrow the symbol universe. Dynamic: evaluated every cycle using real-time market data (price, volume), without needing historical candles. Technical: requires computed candles/indicators (EMA, VWAP, RSI, etc.) and is evaluated on the symbols that already passed the static and dynamic filters.
